    The extended Dynkin quiver of type E₈~ #

    LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.Quiver.AffineE8 is the star with arms of lengths one, two and five, with all arrows pointing towards the centre. Representations with injective arrows are configurations of a subspace, a two-step flag and a five-step flag in the centre space. This is the extended Dynkin diagram T₂,₃,₆; its infinite representation type is proved in LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.RepresentationTheory.Quiver.AffineE8.FiniteRepType. The underlying graph is a tree, with at most one arrow between any two vertices, because every vertex is the source of at most one arrow and every arrow points towards the centre.

    References #

    • Assem–Simson–Skowroński, Elements of the Representation Theory of Associative Algebras I, Chapter VII.
